title: Deep Learning Approaches to Verifiable Credential Anchoring

metadata.abstract: This paper explores deep learning approaches to anchoring verifiable credentials on distributed ledgers, with an emphasis on scalability and privacy-preserving techniques for large-scale document verification pipelines.
